prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 产品对比 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "型号" · longest unbreakable word 29px · one-line width 79px
  col 2: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 50px
  col 3: header "屏幕" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 100px
  col 4: header "续航" · longest unbreakable word 20px · one-line width 59px
  col 5: header "重量" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 39px
  col 6: header "评价" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 445px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者比较四款手机的价格、主要规格和使用体验。","reading":"读者可先按型号定位，再纵向比较价格和规格，最后阅读评价中的使用场景与优缺点；同一行应保持清晰的对应关系。","groups":["型号与价格共同帮助读者识别产品及其价位。","屏幕、续航和重量都是可逐列比较的规格，应保持紧凑且易于扫读。","评价是较长的描述性文字，需要更多宽度，并可借用行高自然换行。"],"keep_intact":["价格及货币符号","型号中的字母、数字和 Pro、Air、Max 等标识","屏幕尺寸、重量数值及其单位","续航数值及其单位"],"may_wrap":["评价可在自然语义边界换行，通常会决定行高。","屏幕的尺寸与显示技术可分行；较长型号也可在型号名称与后缀之间换行，并利用评价产生的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [100, 71, 121, 80, 60, 287] · table 720×252px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 36, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [100, 71, 85, 70, 60, 333] · table 720×275px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [85, 71, 100, 65, 55, 343] · table 720×275px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"型号、价格和各项规格均保持单行，便于横向对应和纵向比较；评价自然换行，较短的青柠 Air 一行也保持紧凑。","problems":"评价列相对局促，较长评价的第二行仍较长；不过整体层次和行间节奏最清晰。","cause":"屏幕列为121px，足以容纳完整规格，但占用了可供评价使用的宽度；评价列为287px。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"型号、价格和重量保持完整；333px 的评价列让描述更舒展，屏幕尺寸与显示技术分行后仍容易理解。","problems":"前两款手机的续航数值与“天”分离，影响快速比较；所有数据行都变高，而短评价一行留下较多空白。","cause":"70px 的续航列不足以容纳最长的完整续航值；85px 的屏幕列使四款屏幕规格均换行。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"343px 的评价列较宽，价格保持单行，屏幕规格分行的方式也较一致。","problems":"型号后缀 Pro、续航单位“天”和重量单位 g 分别与前面的内容分开，规格比较变得吃力；重量列尤其显得拥挤。","cause":"85px 的型号列不足以容纳最长型号，65px 的续航列和55px 的重量列也不足以容纳完整的数值及单位。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[100,71,110,80,60,298],"change":"以 r0A 为基础，将屏幕列缩窄11px并转给评价列；保留完整型号、价格、续航和重量，让评价稍宽，同时观察最长屏幕规格是否自然分行。"},{"name":"screen-split","widths":[100,71,90,80,60,318],"change":"主动允许屏幕尺寸与显示技术分行，为评价多提供31px；恢复足够的续航宽度，避免 r0B 中数值与单位分离。"},{"name":"compact-model","widths":[90,71,100,80,60,318],"change":"尝试让最长型号在名称与 Pro 之间换行，以换取较宽的评价列；屏幕列适度收窄，同时保持续航和重量完整，检验型号换行是否仍便于定位。"}]}
